sents.en: But something quiet and small doesn't seem too scary.
sents.ko: 그런데 조용하고 작은 건 그렇게 무섭지 않아 보여요.

sents.en: Unless, oh no!
This is no good at all!
If the monster escaped, where is it now?
Did the monster on the bus escape on my street?
sents.ko: 버스에 있던 괴물이 우리 동네로 도망친 걸까요?

sents.en: Did it scare all the kids home?
sents.ko: 그래서 아이들을 모두 집으로 놀래 보낸 걸까요?

sents.en: Everyone, except me?
I tiptoe to my house, keeping a watchful eye for any monster trying to sneak by.
sents.ko: 저는 살금살금 집으로 가면서, 몰래 다가오는 괴물이 없는지 눈을 크게 뜨고 살펴요.

sents.en: I reach my front door, turn the knob, and push.
Rawr!
Ahhhh!!!!
Just as the monster jumps out from a bush!
I was right about this monster.
sents.ko: 이 괴물에 대해 제 생각이 맞았어요.

sents.en: He is furless and small.
But I look a little closer and find he's no monster at all.
sents.ko: 그런데 조금 더 가까이 보니, 괴물이 전혀 아니었어요.

sents.en: I lift up the mask... and take a peek under.
sents.ko: 가면을 들어 올리고… 아래를 살짝 들여다봐요.

sents.en: And just who do I discover?
I've found that monsters don't ride the bus home from school.
sents.ko: 괴물은 학교에서 버스를 타고 집에 오지 않는다는 걸 알았어요.

sents.en: But most of the time, little brothers do.
Oh! What would it be like if there are monsters around you?
sents.ko: 오! 여러분 주변에 괴물이 있다면 어떨까요?

sents.en: Would you be scared? Or would you become friends with the monsters?
I think I will be friends with the monster.
sents.ko: 저는 괴물과 친구가 될 것 같아요.

sents.en: If I make monster friends, I'll introduce you. I promise.
sents.ko: 괴물 친구를 만들면 소개해 줄게요. 약속해요.
